paragraphs: Everspot sells cemetery software meant to hold all the tools you need to manage your cemetery in one system. It comes from a team of prior cemetery operators redefining cemetery software after finding the existing options wanting. New customers can join hundreds of cemeteries already using Everspot with no credit card required.

Maps are GPS-enabled, with walk-to-site directions and public access for visitors looking for a grave. A global search finds any burial, customer, or document in milliseconds. Deeds and certificates are generated from built-in or custom templates. Work orders can be created, assigned, and tracked for grounds maintenance and other operations. Bookkeeping syncs with QuickBooks Online or exports journal entries. Paid tiers add memorial (monument) tracking.

The company says hundreds of cemeteries across the United States and Canada use it to manage their operations. Before starting the company, the team ran cemeteries spread across Pennsylvania and Ohio. One founder, Cash, managed multiple cemeteries prior to founding Everspot.

quote.text: We couldn't find the cemetery software we wanted, so we built it ourselves.
